traps.name: Ipswich Town
traps.why: Ipswich went up as runners-up in 2023-24.

questions.prompt: Name a country that beat Brazil at a World Cup
questions.subtitle: Wins in normal or extra time, 1930 to 2022 (shootouts don't count)
questions.prompt_es: Nombra una selección que ganó a Brasil en un Mundial
questions.subtitle_es: Victorias en tiempo reglamentario o prórroga, de 1930 a 2022 (las tandas no cuentan)

traps.name: Croatia
traps.why: The 2022 quarter-final ended 1-1; Croatia went through on penalties, which doesn't count as a win here.
traps.why_es: El cuarto de final de 2022 acabó 1-1; Croacia pasó en los penaltis, que aquí no cuentan como victoria.

traps.name: West Germany
traps.why: West Germany never beat Brazil at a World Cup; the 7-1 was unified Germany in 2014.
traps.why_es: Alemania Occidental nunca ganó a Brasil en un Mundial; el 7-1 fue de la Alemania unificada en 2014.

traps.name: Sweden
traps.why: Sweden lost the 1958 final and the 1994 semi-final to Brazil.
traps.why_es: Suecia perdió ante Brasil la final de 1958 y la semifinal de 1994.
